changes: New module: on the pattern screen, FUNC + YES keeps a temporary copy of the active pattern and its whole Part, scenes included; FUNC + NO puts both back, also while playing.
The crossfader, the selected scenes and the mutes stay where they are. Your saved Part and the clipboard are not touched, so RELOAD PART still returns to your last Part save.
On another pattern, bank or project FUNC + NO shows NO TEMP SAVE. The copy is gone after a power-off: save the Part and the project to keep your work.
FUNC + YES and FUNC + NO no longer repeat ARM ALL and DISARM ALL on the pattern screen; YES and NO alone still do, and menus and sample previews are unchanged.
Known issue: tested on one MKII over USB, not yet on the MKI or as a card build.
